caption_editorial: Brick, stone, and twilight glow. The Majestic at Pine Woods pairs a classic façade with main-floor living and room to grow upstairs. Ready now. Comment MAJESTIC for details.
caption_lifestyle: Coffee at the island, homework in the library, movie night in the upstairs bonus room. At The Majestic in Pine Woods, every day has its place, and the keys are ready today.
caption_feature: Main-floor primary suite with tray ceiling. Main-floor library. Island kitchen, wide-plank floors, upstairs loft + bonus room, 3-car garage. Immediate occupancy. DM TOUR
first_comment_hook: The wagon-wheel candle chandelier in the great room or the frosted glass pantry door in the kitchen: which detail caught your eye first? 👇
alt_text: Photo 1: Twilight exterior of The Majestic, a dark brick home with a stone-clad center gable, arched entry, warm glowing windows, a three-car garage, landscaped beds with boulders, and a young tree on a freshly sodded lawn under a dusky blue and orange sky. Photo 2: Open kitchen and dining area with gray shaker cabinets, white subway tile backsplash, light quartz counters, a center island with three leather barstools, globe pendant lights, a drum pendant over a walnut dining table, wide-plank wood floors, and tall windows and sliding doors framing evergreen trees. Photo 3: Great room with a black wagon-wheel candle chandelier and tall windows, looking through a wide cased opening into a dining nook with a round pedestal table and the kitchen beyond, with a hallway to the right and a white acoustic guitar on a stand. Photo 4: Primary bedroom with a tray ceiling, upholstered bed in sage and white linens with a cable-knit throw, a backlit floating shelf, a window framing green trees, a quatrefoil mirror, and a wood media console. Photo 5: Home office viewed through an open white paneled door, featuring a walnut executive desk with a computer, a black wall clock, a floating shelf with decor, wood wall art, and a large window overlooking open green space and a tree line.

reel_script.0-2s: Slow push-in on the twilight exterior: glowing windows, brick and stone gable, arched entry. Text: 'The Majestic · Pine Woods · Ready Now'
reel_script.2-5s: Glide through the great room beneath the wagon-wheel chandelier, revealing the cased opening into the dining nook and kitchen. Text: 'Open great room living'
reel_script.5-8s: Sweep along the kitchen island past the leather stools, gray shaker cabinets, and subway tile, ending on the wooded view through the sliders. Text: 'Island kitchen + dining nook'
reel_script.8-10s: Quick cuts: primary suite tray ceiling and backlit shelf, then a door swinging open to the library desk and green view. Text: 'Primary suite + library on the main floor'
reel_script.10-12s: Hold on the exterior at dusk with the L&R Homes logo. Text: 'Upstairs loft + bonus room · 3093 Raffler Dr · DM TOUR'
